name: Youjinbou no Ookami-san. ~Ookami to Shoujo no Yakusoku~
original_name: ようじんぼうのオオカミさん。～狼と少女の約束～
source:
High fantasy romance based on Norse mythology, starring a goddess wolf protagonist named Haty. 
She's joined by Calsy the summoner, her unusual friend Kuva and a ghost who lingers around her, Fenryl.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE101945.html]DLsite English[/url]]
